name: DevNotes
author: Alex Hedström

sections.description:
DevNotes adds a clean, modern note and task management interface directly inside your WordPress admin area. It is designed for site administrators who want a quick way to jot down notes, track tasks, and stay organized without leaving the dashboard.

Features:

  • Notes – Create, edit, archive, and search text notes.
  • Tasks – Create tasks with due dates, assign them to admin users, and mark them as finished.
  • Dashboard Widget – See recent notes and upcoming tasks right on the WordPress dashboard.
  • Admin Bar Menu – Quickly add a new note or task from anywhere in the admin area.
  • Post Meta Box – Notes and tasks linked to the post, page, or other item you are editing.
  • Breakdance Builder – A DevNotes button in the builder top bar opens the same notes and tasks for the page being edited. Requires Breakdance 2.8 or newer.
  • Screen Links – A note remembers the admin screen it was created on.
  • Pins – Pin a note or task to the top of the list.
  • Task Filters – Show tasks assigned to you, unassigned tasks, or finished tasks.
  • Due Count – The admin bar shows how many tasks are due today or overdue.
  • Assignment Alerts – The assignee gets an admin notice, and an email when that option is on.
  • Tabbed Interface – Dashboard overview, Notes, Tasks, and Archive tabs for easy navigation.
  • Search – Search the full list of notes, tasks, and archived items. Filter the archive by item type.
  • Due Date Indicators – Tasks display overdue and due-today warnings at a glance.
  • User Assignment – Assign tasks to any administrator on the site.
  • CSV Export/Import – Export all data to CSV or import from a CSV file for easy migration.
  • Clear Data – Option to permanently delete all DevNotes data from the Settings page.
  • Translations – Ships in English. A translation template is included at languages/devnotes.pot so other languages can be added.
  • REST API – Full REST API support for programmatic access to notes and tasks (devnotes/v1 namespace).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the devnotes folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to DevNotes in the admin sidebar to start adding notes and tasks.
sections.faq:
Who can access DevNotes?

Only users with the manage_options capability (typically Administrators) can view and manage DevNotes items.

Where is the data stored?

All notes and tasks are stored in a custom database table (wp_devnotes_items) created on plugin activation.

Can I migrate my data to another site?

Yes. Go to DevNotes > Settings to export your data as a CSV file, then import it on the destination site using the same settings page.

Does DevNotes work inside Breakdance?

Yes, with Breakdance 2.8 or newer. Open the builder and use the DevNotes button in the top bar. The sidebar lists notes and tasks linked to the document you are editing. Administrators only. There is no public Breakdance slot for this panel, so a future builder redesign can move the button until DevNotes is updated.

Does the plugin work on post edit screens?

Yes. A meta box appears while you are editing a post, page, or other public item. It lists notes and tasks linked to that item, and new ones are linked to it.

Is there a REST API?

Yes. DevNotes includes a full REST API under the devnotes/v1 namespace with endpoints for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting items. All endpoints require the manage_options capability (Administrator role).

What security measures are in place?

DevNotes includes comprehensive security hardening: nonce protection on all forms, sanitization and validation of all user inputs, capability checks to restrict access to administrators only, prepared SQL statements to prevent injection attacks, and safe redirects after data operations.
